sections.heading: Put predictive insight to work
sections.body:
The Predictive Analytics Suite brings reusable models to customer, demand and risk decisions. It provides a starting point for turning patterns in your data into practical predictions.

Use it to explore customer churn and segmentation, forecast demand, flag unusual activity and assess loan default risk. Adapt each model to your data and decision context, with outputs your teams can review and act on.

sections.heading: Models for customer, demand and risk decisions

cards.title: Churn & segmentation
cards.description: Identify customers at risk of leaving and group customers by shared behaviours to inform retention and engagement.

cards.title: Demand forecasting
cards.description: Use historical demand patterns to estimate future needs and support planning for products, capacity and resources.

cards.title: Fraud & anomaly detection
cards.description: Flag unusual patterns in transactions and activity so teams can prioritise investigation and review.

cards.title: Loan default prediction
cards.description: Estimate default risk from relevant lending data to support credit assessment and ongoing portfolio review.

sections.heading: From a decision question to a usable model

items.description: Define the decision to support, the prediction required and how your team will use the result.
Review relevant data for quality, availability and suitability before adapting the reusable model.
Test predictions against historical outcomes and agree how results will be interpreted and reviewed.
Connect model outputs to the decision workflow and monitor them as data and business conditions change.
